question: Please provide a list of the top three revenue-generating films for each actor, along with the average revenue per actor in those films, calculated by dividing the total film revenue equally among the actors for each film.
sql:
WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT i.film_id, SUM(p.amount) as total_revenue
    FROM payment p
    JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    GROUP BY i.film_id
),
actors_per_film AS (
    SELECT film_id, COUNT(actor_id) as num_actors
    FROM film_actor
    GROUP BY film_id
),
film_actor_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        fr.film_id,
        fr.total_revenue,
        apf.num_actors,
        fr.total_revenue / apf.num_actors as revenue_per_actor
    FROM film_revenue fr
    JOIN actors_per_film apf ON fr.film_id = apf.film_id
),
actor_film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.actor_id,
        fa.film_id,
        far.revenue_per_actor,
        far.total_revenue
    FROM film_actor fa
    JOIN film_actor_revenue far ON fa.film_id = far.film_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        actor_id,
        film_id,
        revenue_per_actor,
        total_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id ORDER BY revenue_per_actor DESC) as rn
    FROM actor_film_revenue
),
top3 AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn <= 3
)
SELECT 
    a.actor_id,
    a.first_name,
    a.last_name,
    f.title,
    ROUND(r.total_revenue, 2) as total_revenue,
    ROUND(r.revenue_per_actor, 2) as revenue_per_actor,
    ROUND(AVG(r.revenue_per_actor) OVER (PARTITION BY a.actor_id), 2) as avg_revenue_per_actor
FROM top3 r
JOIN actor a ON r.actor_id = a.actor_id
JOIN film f ON r.film_id = f.film_id
ORDER BY a.actor_id, r.rn
